Akkio

Akkio is an AI analytics platform focused on letting teams create domain-specific analytical agents and embed AI-driven analysis into workflows.

What is Akkio?

Akkio packages conversational analytics and domain-specific AI agents for organizations that want to turn recurring data questions into reusable workflows. Its current positioning is particularly strong around agency and business analytics, with options to customize, integrate and embed analytical experiences rather than relying only on one-off chats.

Best for: Agencies and business teams that want customized AI analytics agents connected to their own reporting and client-data workflows.

Main features

  • Domain-specific AI analytics agents
  • Conversational data exploration
  • Custom analytical workflows
  • Embeddable analytics experiences
  • Enterprise integrations
  • REST API

Use cases

  • Build a client-facing analytics agent
  • Analyze campaign or business-performance data
  • Automate recurring analytical questions
  • Embed AI analytics into an existing product or portal
  • Connect data workflows through API integrations

Who is it for?

  • media agencies
  • analytics teams
  • business intelligence teams
  • client-service teams
  • software teams embedding analytics

Pricing and plans

enterprise subscription / custom pricing

Advantages

  • Agent-oriented approach for repeatable domain-specific analysis
  • Supports SaaS and embedded deployment patterns
  • Official REST API documentation is available

Limitations

  • Current public pricing is sales-led rather than self-service
  • The product's present positioning is narrower and more agency-focused than broad general-purpose analytics platforms
  • The documented REST API is labeled beta, so interfaces may evolve

Frequently asked questions

Does Akkio publish a self-service starting price?

No numerical self-service starting price was shown on the current official pricing page checked; the enterprise offering uses contact-sales pricing.

Can Akkio be embedded in another product?

Yes. Akkio's current offering includes embedded usage and integrations for organizations that want analytics inside their own workflows.

Is the Akkio REST API stable?

Akkio publishes a REST API, but the official API introduction labels it beta, which is a meaningful consideration for production integrations.
